notes.title: Update record for September 10
notes.content:
・Your data is automatically saved when switching maps. 

・If you pick up items and it exceeds the limit of the number you have, they are sent to the item box.

notes.title: The playtest of the action-adventure game "ONENELLEMOO" is underway.
notes.content:
[h1] The playtest of ONENELLEMOO is underway. [/h1]
I would be very happy if you could write your impressions of playing this game on the online bulletin board.
It would be very helpful if you could write how you felt about the difficulty.
If you find a bug, please report it.

[h2] Playtest Volume [/h2]
On Playtest, you can play about 2/3 of the upcoming Chapter 1.

[h2] Supported OS [/h2]
Windows and Mac
